stimulus.body: 材料背景：An architect's brief finds that 'password123' and 'qwerty' are among the most used passwords. Attackers try these first in credential stuffing attacks. 下面是一则简短材料，用来考查这一用法的理解。材料中写道：「s brief finds that」。材料后给出四个选项，只有一个选项与材料本身所提供的信息相符。

questions.stem: 结合提示“Recognise that common passwords are weak / Follow attacker strategy. / Password length and complexity”，哪一项真正得到材料的支持？.

options.misconception: substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the relation the passage establishes

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: common passwords are tried first by attackers. On that basis "Attackers try them first" is the supported choice. Option A ("They are too long") fails because it substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for password length and complexity; Option C ("They contain no letters") fails because it factually wrong about these examples; Option D ("They expire too quickly") fails because it invents an expiry issue.
